Bill.BriefDescription: Transferring funds from the budget stabilization account to the general fund.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transferring funds from the budget stabilizationaccount to the general fund; and making appropriations.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state treasurer shall transfer onehundred forty million ninetyeight thousand dollars or as much as isavailable from the budget stabilization account to the state generalfund for fiscal year 2012. (2) The state treasurer shall transfer one hundred fortyninemillion four hundred eightyfour thousand dollars or as much as isavailable from the budget stabilization account to the state generalfund for fiscal year 2013.
